bearing.model.v1alpha1.Authority.schema..description:
Authority is a source's claim to be the source of record. It is a message
 so levels can be added later without breaking declarations or overrides.

authoritative.description: True when the source is the source of record. Default false.

bearing.model.v1alpha1.LinkDeclaration.s.description:
LinkDeclaration declares a key type of another system that this system
 records for the entity (linked_ids).

^(keyType)$.description: A key type declared for that issuer type.

key_type.description: A key type declared for that issuer type.
